name: Skullsplitter Tusk
summary: A Skullsplitter Tusk is a troll’s tusk used to forge false tiger fangs for sale in the South Seas. Kebok in Booty Bay wants a large shipment for his trade.

sections.title: A False Fang
sections.body: Kebok in Booty Bay sends you after the Skullsplitter trolls for their tusks. Their tusks make convincing copies of tiger fangs, which are costly to gather from the beasts themselves. The forgeries go into a shipment bound for the islands of the South Seas.

faq.answer: A Skullsplitter Tusk is a troll’s tusk that Kebok uses to make false tiger fangs.
Kebok in Booty Bay wants Skullsplitter Tusks for his shipment of forged tiger fangs.

faq.q: Why does Kebok need the tusks?
faq.answer: Kebok uses Skullsplitter Tusks as convincing forgeries of tiger fangs, which are costly to gather.

faq.q: Where do Skullsplitter Tusks come from?
faq.answer: The tusks come from Skullsplitter trolls in Stranglethorn Vale.
